description: Source code for the InstallationManager class managing software installation slots, rollbacks, and updates in a system, including file operations, priority management, and state persistence.

classes.name: InstallationManager
classes.description: Manages installation slots, rollbacks, and updates, including persistence and priority management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the installation manager, loads or creates the installation store, and sets up directories.

methods.name: GetAppKey
methods.description: Retrieves the application key.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberInstallations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of installation slots.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the installation store to default state.

methods.name: CreateInstallationStore
methods.description: Creates a new installation store with default slot states.

methods.name: DumpInstallationSlots
methods.description: Returns a string representation of current installation slots and statuses.

methods.name: GetInstallationStatus
methods.description: Returns whether a specific installation slot is successful.

methods.name: GetInstallationNumTriesLeft
methods.description: Returns remaining tries for an installation slot.

methods.name: DecrementInstallationNumTries
methods.description: Decreases the number of tries left for an installation slot.

methods.name: RevertToSuccessfulInstallation
methods.description: Reverts to a previous successful installation, adjusting priorities accordingly.

methods.name: RollForward
methods.description: Rolls forward to a specified installation slot, making it highest priority.

methods.name: RollForwardIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs roll forward if a pending installation is set.

methods.name: RollForwardInternal
methods.description: Internal method to perform the roll forward operation.

methods.name: ShiftPrioritiesInRange
methods.description: Adjusts priorities of installation slots within a range.

methods.name: GetInstallationPath
methods.description: Retrieves the filesystem path for a given installation slot.

methods.name: GetCurrentInstallationIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current active installation.

methods.name: LogLastSystemError
methods.description: Logs the last system error message.

methods.name: FindCurrentInstallationIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the highest priority successful installation.

methods.name: MarkInstallationSuccessful
methods.description: Marks a specific installation slot as successful.

methods.name: SelectNewInstallationIndex
methods.description: Selects a new installation slot based on priority.

methods.name: ResetInstallation
methods.description: Resets a specific installation slot to initial state.

methods.name: RequestRollForwardToInstallation
methods.description: Sets a specific installation slot to be rolled forward to.

methods.name: SaveInstallationStore
methods.description: Serializes and saves the installation store to disk.

methods.name: InitInstallationStorePath
methods.description: Initializes filesystem paths for storing installation data.

methods.name: IsValidIndex
methods.description: Checks if an installation index is valid.

methods.name: ValidatePriorities
methods.description: Ensures installation priorities are unique and valid.

methods.name: LoadInstallationStore
methods.description: Loads the installation store from disk.

methods.name: GetInstallationPathInternal
methods.description: Computes the filesystem path for an installation slot.

methods.name: CreateInstallationDirs
methods.description: Creates directories for installation slots.

methods.name: CleanInstallationDirs
methods.description: Removes directories for installation slots.
